clusters.headline: Armed Men Hold Twenty-Five Hostages At A Supermarket In Cartagena
aiSummaryBullets: Approximately 25 individuals are being held hostage by gunmen inside a supermarket located in Cartagena, Colombia.
The standoff began after the armed group attempted to rob an armored truck and subsequently fled into the store.

clusters.headline: Colombian President De La Espriella Blames FARC For Car Bomb Attack
aiSummaryBullets: President De la Espriella officially blamed FARC rebels for orchestrating the car bomb explosion.
Initial reports stated at least 23 people were injured, with updated figures noting up to 25 casualties.
